subject: Thanks for attending Redwood webinar — quick demo?

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Collins <sarah.collins@acme.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Thanks for attending Redwood webinar — quick demo?

Hi Sarah,

Thanks again for joining our webinar earlier today — really appreciate you taking the time. A few attendees asked for a short follow-up demo looking specifically at inference latency, cost tradeoffs, and deployment options, and I wanted to see if you'd be open to a 30-minute walkthrough tailored to Acme.

Quick suggested times next week (all PDT):
• Wed Oct 14 — 10:00–10:30am
• Wed Oct 14 — 2:00–2:30pm
• Thu Oct 15 — 11:00–11:30am

If none of those work, share a couple windows that do and I’ll send a calendar invite. Happy to include an agenda focused on: your current inference stack, cost targets, and a short Q&A.

Would Tom or anyone else on your team like to join?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sales Development Representative | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132

P.S. Here’s the webinar deck if you want to scan ahead: https://redwood.app/slides/webinar-oct-2026

> Hi Sarah,
> 
> Thanks again for joining our webinar earlier today — really appreciate you taking the time. A few attendees asked for a short follow-up demo...

Thanks Marissa — great webinar. We’d be interested in a focused walkthrough that covers:
• Latency and throughput on multi-tenant vs. dedicated setups
• Typical per-token cost at 1k vs 10k QPS
• Data handling and private deployment options for regulated workloads

Tom (cc’d) will join. The times you suggested don’t quite work for us on Oct 14, but Thu Oct 15 after 3:00pm PDT looks possible. Would 3:30pm on Oct 15 work for you?

Thanks,
Sarah Collins
Senior Product Manager | Acme Corp
sarah.collins@acme.com
